repo.description: A simple code complexity analyser without caring about the C/C++ header files or Java imports, supports most of the popular languages.
repo.name: lizard

metadata.body:
Since ceb899aa, Lizard loses Java methods in two common Spring/JPA patterns, and the latest release ships with this. Comparing Lizard with a Java parser (tree-sitter-java) on real projects also turned up older cases where methods were missed, invented or misnamed. This PR fixes all of them; each fix has a test that fails without it.

## Regressions from ceb899aa

| Example | Before | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@Entity @Table(name = "vets") class Vet { ... }` | 0 methods | After `@Entity`, `_state_post_decorator` dropped the next token (`@`), so `Table(...)` was read as a method whose body was the whole class | Pass the token on to `_state_global`, as before ceb899aa |
| `void f() { @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") List<String> x = ...; } void g() {}` | `g` and every later method lost | The annotation's `(...)` was skipped with the bracket counter the method body shares with its own `{`, which never returned to 0 | Method bodies don't declare methods, so they no longer handle annotations specially |

## Older cases (also in ceb899aa^)

| Example | Before | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| record with `R(int x) { this(x, 0); }` | every method in the record lost | Only the compact constructor `R { }` is skipped; an explicit one is reported |
| `@interface M { String value() default "m"; }` | fake function `value`, could swallow the rest of the file | `default ...;` after `()` ends the element |
| `enum Op { PLUS("+") { int apply() {...} }; }` | fake function `PLUS`, `apply` lost | In an enum body, nothing before the first `;` is a method |
| local `record P(int a) { int sum() {...} }` in a method | `sum` lost | In a method body, `record` followed by a name declares a record |
| `class A { class B {...} void g() {} }` | `B::g` | The outer class's name comes back after a nested type ends |
| `interface I { default int a() {...} }` | `a` (no class name) | `interface` starts a type like `class` |

## Results

On 11 open-source repos (caddy, eShopOnWeb, excalidraw, mastodon, monica, nest, redis, ripgrep, saleor, spring-petclinic, teammates): Java functions 119,032 → 119,554 compared with master, in 30 files, and no file reports fewer. Examples: spring-petclinic `Owner.java` 0 → 13, `PetController.java` 0 → 12; teammates `FeedbackSession.java` 0 → 65, `AppPage.java` 26 → 66. What master reported and this branch doesn't: 6 annotations reported as functions (e.g. `BaseEntity::GeneratedValue`) and 15 methods of `@Nested` inner classes that now carry the inner class's name. NLOC and CCN are unchanged for every function both versions report. No non-Java file changes.

Lizard now matches tree-sitter-java on every method and constructor with a body (name, class prefix, start and end line): 6,937 in those repos and 50,869 in five other Java projects. Master misses or misnames 556 and 2,588 of them respectively.

Checks: the test suite passes (3133 passed, 7 skipped), `make pep8` is clean, and the pylint score is unchanged.
